# Preview video fixture

`preview.webm` is synthetic footage generated by the local capture test on
2026-09-15: a blue page with a button, clicked after 600 ms to turn the background
coral. It contains one silent VP8 track at 960 × 600, recorded by the pinned
Playwright 1.63.0 tooling. No external footage or personal content is included.

`tests/services/preview-video.test.ts` contains the source scene and recording
recipe, and checks a decoded post-click pixel. This checked-in copy keeps unit
metadata/container/cache/publication tests independent of browser installation.
